newsitem.title: USA: Gen Instrument announces restructuring terms.
newsitem.headline: Gen Instrument announces restructuring terms.

text.p: General Instrument Corp on Thursday announced the terms under which it will divide into three publically traded companies.

The company said that for each outstanding share of General Instrument stock shareholders will get one share of NextLevel Systems, one-third share of CommScope and one-quarter share of General Semiconductor.
The company said that -- subject to shareholder approval -- the three companies will start trading as separate public companies on July 28.
The company said its combined annual and special meeting of stockholders will be held on July 23.
The record date to vote at the meeting is June 10, the company added.
